The structure of La2ZnBiO6 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies La and Zn centers in octahedral coordination by oxygen, while Bi centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 oxygen neighbors. The octahedra share corners between La and Zn, and face-sharing is observed between La octahedra and Bi 12-vertex coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
